query.title: Name to search (for a single lookup)
query.description: Individual or firm name to look up. Leave the Queries (multiple) field below empty to use this single-lookup shortcut instead.

searchType.title: Search type (for a single lookup)
searchType.description: Only used together with the Name field above.

state.title: State filter (optional, individual search only)
state.description: Two-letter state code to narrow results, e.g. "NY". Only used together with the Name field above.

queries.title: Queries (multiple)
queries.description: For looking up several names in one run instead of one at a time. One entry per query: { "query": "name", "searchType": "individual"|"firm", "state": "NY" }. Ignored if Name above is filled in.

maxResults.title: Max results per query
maxResults.description: Maximum number of matches to return per name searched.
